battle.name: 羅唐戰爭
battle.brief: 唐咸亨元年（670）起，新羅扶高句麗遺民反唐、兼取百濟故地，唐安東都護府自平壤退守熊津一線，與新羅軍拉鋸六年，至咸亨五年（676）罷兵。卡面的亞述長矛未隨軍東渡，但短柄鐵鏃長矛正是兩軍骨幹：唐軍以方陣執槊拒馬，新羅則以騎兵持矛反覆衝撞。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 羅唐戰爭（韓語作나당전쟁，日語作唐・新羅戰爭），指唐咸亨元年（670）至咸亨五年（676）唐朝與新羅王國在朝鮮半島的一場六年戰爭，交戰雙方各挾歸附勢力。唐朝一方由皇帝高宗李治在長安遙控，前線以行軍大總管、行軍大將軍統兵，據點是平壤的安東都護府，其下設都督府、州、縣，並羈縻歸附的高句麗、百濟遺民；兵員自幽州、萊州經遼東陸路與渤海海道運抵，統帥先後有契苾何力、高侃、劉仁軌、李謹行、薛仁貴等，編制是府兵與募兵混編的步兵為主，騎兵與水軍配合。新羅一方以金氏王權為核心，金城設執事大等合議中央；善德王之後由文武王金春秋執政，其漢名法敏，咸亨年間扶高句麗王安舜建報德國，並派兵攻取百濟故地。兵源以部為單位編制，設十人將與各級將領分轄，並吸收高句麗、百濟降卒與地方義兵。兩軍的成敗關鍵在後勤：唐靠山東、遼東的粟米與海船支應，戰線一退，糧道即拉長；新羅就地徵糧、以城固守，供給短而穩，這是六年消耗戰中最要命的變數。
countriesEn: The Luo-Tang war (Korean: 나당전쟁; Japanese: 唐・新羅戦争) is the name for the six-year war fought on the Korean peninsula between the Tang dynasty and the kingdom of Silla from the first year of Xianheng (670) to the fifth year of that era (676), each side sheltering the remnants of the states it had absorbed. On the Tang side the Emperor Gaozong, Li Zhi, directed the business from Chang'an while the front was commanded by generals-at-large and great generals of the marching armies; the chief base was the Protectorate General to Pacify the East at Pyongyang, and beneath it stood dufu offices, prefectures and counties, together with the jimi control of the surrendered Goguryeo and Baekje people. The troops came from Youzhou and Laizhou by land through Liaodong and by sea across the Bohai, and the commanders in turn were Qibi Heli, Gao Kan, Liu Renjgui, Li Jinxing and Xue Rengui; the force mixed fubing with recruited infantry, with cavalry and a water force in support. On the Silla side the state centred on the Kim monarchy; the capital at Jinshi ran the central government through a council of the jipdaedale. After King Seongdeok came King Munmu, Kim Chunchu, whose Chinese name was Famin, and in the years of Xianheng he set up the kingdom of Boguk for the Goguryeo king An Shun and sent troops to seize the old lands of Baekje. The men were organised by departments, with officers of the party of ten and other grades above them, and men who had surrendered from Goguryeo and Baekje, together with local irregulars, were folded into the Silla ranks. The decisive variable in the war was supply. The Tang drew millet from Shandong and Liaodong and carried it in seagoing ships, so every withdrawal of the front lengthened the grain road; Silla levied grain on the spot and sat behind its own walls, which kept its supply short but steady, and that was the single most damaging variable in a war of six years' attrition.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩營。唐方，最高決策在高宗李治；上元元年（674）他與新羅文武王徹底決裂，扶植金仁問送上王位，並遣劉仁軌領兵東征。劉仁軌曾於大非川之戰對吐蕃失利而一度被除名，復出後於上元二年（675）二月渡瓠盧河，在阿達城與七重城連敗新羅，是唐軍攻勢最盛之時。薛仁貴是本戰役最知名之將：他以大非川之功被任為雞林道總管，負責羈縻熊津都督府，又於675年率歸附的靺鞨兵攻石峴城、赤木城、買肖城，三戰皆捷，是唐方在半島站穩腳跟的唯一攻勢。契苾何力平定高句麗復國勢力，斬首萬級、溺死者數萬，是唐方在遼東一線的柱石；高侃奉詔鎮壓安舜勢力；李謹行以行軍總管、安東鎮撫大使之任統軍。新羅方，文武王金春秋決策反唐，執事大等分掌外交、兵糧與州郡；金法敏兩度遣使入唐謝罪；金仁問作為新羅王子留於唐廷為質，675年奉召途中而返，改封臨海郡公；金元述在買肖城擊敗唐軍，一度挽回新羅戰局。前高句麗將領劍牟岑扶高句麗王室安舜於百濟故地建國，高句麗將高延武與新羅將薛烏儒曾聯兵攻遼東；百濟宗室扶餘隆奉唐命為熊津都督，滯留長安不敢歸國，高寶藏與扶餘隆在半島另建唐室羈縻都督府的計畫終告落空。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into two camps. On the Tang side the highest decisions belonged to Gaozong. In the first year of Shangyuan (674) he broke with King Munmu of Silla for good, promoted Kim Inmun to the throne and sent Liu Renjgui east with an army. Liu Renjgui had already been dismissed after the defeat at Dafeichuan, and after his reinstatement he crossed the Huru River in the second month of 675 and beat the Silla army at Acheng and at Chuncheng, which was the high tide of the Tang offensive. The best known commander of the war was Xue Rengui: credited with the victory at Dafeichuan, he was made general of the Gilim circuit in charge of the dependent office of the Xiongjin dufu, and in 675 he led Mohe troops who had come over to the Tang against Silla at Seokhyeon, Cheokmok and Maesobuk, winning all three, the one Tang offensive on the peninsula that held ground. Qibi Heli crushed the Goguryeo restoration movement, cutting down some ten thousand by the sword and drowning several thousand more, and was the pillar of the Tang on the Liaodong front; Gao Kan was sent to put down the rising of An Shun; and Li Jinxing led the troops as moving army chief and commissioner for the pacification of the East. On the Silla side King Munmu, Kim Chunchu, made the decision to turn on the Tang, with the jipdaedale dividing foreign affairs, supply and the provincial administrations; Famin twice sent envoys to the Tang court to apologise; Kim Inmun, a Silla prince, was kept at the Tang court as a hostage, was summoned home in 675 and turned back on the way, and was re-invested as prince of Linhai; and Kim Won-seo beat the Tang army at Maesobuk, briefly turning the course of the war. Among the actors from the fallen states, the former Goguryeo general Geom Moseum set up the Goguryeo royal house An Shun in the old lands of Baekje, the Goguryeo general Go Yeonmu and the Silla general Sul Uru once marched in concert against Liaodong; and the Baekje prince Buyeo Lung was appointed dufu of Xiongjin by the Tang but stayed at Chang'an and dared not go home, the plan of Buyeo Lung and Go Bojang to set up a Tang client office on the peninsula came to nothing in the end.
kits: 本卡兵器是亞述長矛（Assyrian spear）：短柄、長刃、配著鐵鏃，亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落；它標示的是長矛在冷兵器軍隊中作為近戰骨幹與推進工具的地位。必須說明的是，這件兵器並未隨軍東渡七世紀的朝鮮半島，但兩河流域的短柄長矛經西域與草原路線東傳，與本地長柄結合，成為唐、新羅兵器共同的母型。唐軍步兵的長矛以槊、拒馬槊為主，槊桿長度史無明文，兵書所記自一丈至數丈不等，鋒作小鏃，列陣時以長槊拒馬、壓住敵前驅，近身之後換橫刀；騎兵用馬槊，騎士右手執槊衝陣，以唐刀（直刃環首刀）為副兵器，弓弩以自強弩與角弓為主，攻城另有擲石機、飛雲梯、巢車與撞車；唐廷東征的玄甲騎兵更以鐵甲、雙駱馬與長槊作騎戰組合，不過新唐書所記此類具裝騎兵仍屬孤例，規模不過數千，難言是制度化的重裝騎兵。新羅方面，長矛與長刀是主力，弓短而強，配小盾與革甲，馬上有披甲的騎士，花郎之說諸說並存、規模不詳，冶鐵業已能供應大量鐵鏃與刀身。兩軍真正的差距不在矛，而在唐軍的強弩與投石能壓制城頭，新羅的矛兵則善於在城郊短射程內消耗唐軍前鋒。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Assyrian spear: a short-hafted blade with an iron point. The Assyrians bound it together with the bow and with their iron work, and the cities of the two rivers fell one after another; it stands for the place of the spear in a cold-weapon army, as the backbone of close combat and as an instrument of pushing forward. It has to be said that this weapon never crossed to the seventh-century Korean peninsula with any army, and yet the short-hafted spear of Mesopotamia travelled east by the western regions and the steppe routes, and there combined with the local long shaft to become the common ancestor of Tang and Silla weapons. The Tang infantry spear was the shao and the juma shao, the length of the shaft not fixed in the records, the military books giving anything from one zhang to several, with a small point; in the line they used the long shaft to refuse the enemy's advance and to pin the front of the enemy down, and at close quarters they changed to the hengdao. The cavalry used the ma shao, the rider holding the shaft in the right hand as he charged, with the Tang dao, a straight-edged ring-pommel sabre, as his sidearm; bows and crossbows were the composite bow and the strong crossbow, while siege brought in the stone thrower, the scaling ladder, the siege tower and the battering ram. The Tang black-armoured cavalry of the eastern campaigns made a further combination of iron armour, a pair of camels and the long shaft, though the armoured horse recorded in the New Book of Tang remains an isolated case, numbered in the thousands rather than an institutionalised heavy cavalry. On the Silla side the spear and the long sword were the main weapons, the bow short and strong, matched with a small shield and leather armour, and there were armoured riders on horseback, the story of the hwarang being variously given and their numbers unknown; Silla's iron industry was already able to supply iron points and blades in quantity. The real gap between the two armies did not lie in the spear but in the Tang strong crossbows and stone throwers, which could pin down a wall, while the Silla spearmen were adept at grinding down the Tang vanguard at short range outside the walls.
tactics: 唐羅兩軍的戰術分野，在於一方善攻城、一方善守土。668年唐軍滅高句麗時造飛雲梯與巢車，十餘丈的攻城塔貼在安市城的山壁上，士卒緣梯而上破城；羅唐戰爭卻是在唐軍失去主動攻城能力之後才全面爆發。唐軍在半島改以據點線作戰：平壤、熊津、泗沘與黃海沿岸串成一條南北線，遠程以投石機、弓弩消耗敵陣，近距離以長矛方陣與騎兵衝擊相配合，騎兵多作追擊與側擊之用；水軍沿西海與渤海巡弋，掩護由山東登萊裝船、經熊津登陸的糧船，關鍵是海運轉陸運接上平壤的糧道，一旦海路受阻或前線南撤，糧道就整條拉長。新羅的戰法是守城與消耗：以城郭、砦堡節節抵抗，退入太白山脈一帶的隘道，利用山地切割唐軍縱隊、切斷糧道，再以弓兵與矛兵在城郊消耗唐軍前鋒，待其銳氣與糧秣俱竭才反擊。675年劉仁軌渡瓠盧河連破阿達城、七重城，李謹行三戰皆捷，是唐軍最接近成功的時刻；676年薛仁貴渡海至所夫里州伎伐浦與新羅交鋒，卻因遠征而無法追擊到底，戰局就此逆轉。
tacticsEn: The division in tactics between the two armies was between a side good at besieging and a side good at holding ground. When the Tang destroyed Goguryeo in 668 they built scaling ladders and siege towers, a tower of more than ten zhang pressed against the hillside above Anshi, and the soldiers climbed it and took the city; the Luo-Tang war, however, became general only after the Tang had lost the ability to attack on their own initiative. On the peninsula the Tang fought along a chain of strongholds: Pyongyang, Xiongjin, Sabi and the Yellow Sea coast were tied into one north-south line. At range they wore the enemy down with stone throwers, bows and crossbows; at close range they combined the spear square with the cavalry charge, the horse being used mostly for pursuit and for the flanking blow. Their navy patrolled the western sea and the Bohai, escorting the grain boats loaded at Dengzhou and Lai-chou in Shandong and landed at Xiongjin, and the crux was the change from sea to land that carried the grain on to Pyongyang: if the sea route was blocked or the front fell back to the south, the whole grain road was stretched out. Silla fought by holding and by attrition. The walled towns and stockades were defended in turn, the army withdrawing into the passes of the Paektu range, letting the mountains cut the Tang columns and close the supply road, and then bowmen and spearmen outside the walls ground down the Tang vanguard until its momentum and its grain were both spent before the counter-stroke. In 675 Liu Renjgui crossed the Huru River and took Acheng and Chuncheng in turn, and Li Jinxing won all three of his battles; that was the moment when the Tang came closest to success. In 676 Xue Rengui crossed the Yellow Sea to the Jibeolpo in the Sopuri prefecture and engaged the Silla, but a distant expedition could not follow its victory through, and the course of the war reversed there.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但大框架清楚。時間上，戰爭自唐咸亨元年（670）起，到儀鳳三年（676）九月薛仁貴在伎伐浦與新羅交戰，前後約六年；668年唐滅高句麗後分其地為九都督府、四十二州、百縣，安東都護府治平壤。地理上，平壤在北緯三十九度零二分、東經一百二十五度四十五分，熊津故地在今黃海道一帶，泗沘在今忠清南道公州一帶，東西相距約二百公里；唐後方幽州距平壤逾一千公里，山東登萊至熊津的海程約七百海里。兵力方面，三國史記載買肖城之戰新羅軍二十萬、俘獲戰馬三千三百八十匹，中國史書則記唐軍四萬；以李謹行行軍總管的資歷與馬匹數量推斷，唐軍總兵力當在數萬之譜，二十萬或為新羅追擊之敵全軍的虛數。損失方面，676年伎伐浦之戰，新羅方面史料載唐軍被斬首四千餘級，此數中國史家多所存疑。土地方面，統一後新羅統治大同江以南，685年「始備九州」，735年唐廷正式承認新羅對半島南部的控制。
dataEn: Few figures survive that can be checked, but the broad frame is clear. In time, the war ran from the first year of Xianheng (670) to the engagement at Jibeolpo in the ninth month of the third year of Yifeng (676), about six years in all; after destroying Goguryeo in 668 the Tang divided its land into nine dufu offices, forty-two prefectures and a hundred counties, and seated the Protectorate General to Pacify the East at Pyongyang. In geography, Pyongyang lies at 39 degrees 2 minutes north and 125 degrees 45 minutes east, the site of Xiongjin lies in what is now the Hwanghae region, and Sabi lies in the old territory of Sabi in what is now Chungcheongnam-do, roughly two hundred kilometres from Xiongjin to the east; Youzhou in the Tang rear is more than a thousand kilometres from Pyongyang, and the sea run from Dengzhou and Laizhou in Shandong to Xiongjin is about seven hundred nautical miles. On troops, the Samguk Sagi records two hundred thousand Silla men at the battle of Maesobuk with three thousand three hundred and eighty horses captured, while the Chinese histories give the Tang force as forty thousand; judged by the standing of Li Jinxing as moving army chief and by the number of horses, the whole Tang army must have been numbered in the tens of thousands, and the two hundred thousand is likely a round figure for the entire enemy force the Silla claimed to have pursued. On losses, at the battle of Jibeolpo in 676 the Silla records give more than four thousand Tang soldiers cut down, a figure Chinese historians largely doubt. On territory, the unified Silla governed the country south of the Taedong river, in 685 it first set up the nine provinces, and in 735 the Tang court formally recognised Silla's control of the southern peninsula.
cause: 羅唐戰爭的起因有四層。最底層是半島的權力格局：660年新羅聯唐攻滅百濟，668年又與唐聯軍滅高句麗，新羅已佔漢江流域以南大半；唐滅高句麗後設安東都護府於平壤，分郡縣、編戶籍、遷徙其民，並以護府名義治理整個半島，雙方都想獨佔這份權力。第二層是承諾與兌現的落差：唐太宗曾許諾將百濟故地與平壤以南之地交予新羅，換取其出兵相助，太宗未及高句麗事成而崩，高宗事後翻供，新羅認為自己被欺騙。第三層是歸附人口的安置難題：大批高句麗、百濟人口被內遷或編入新羅郡縣，地方抵抗因此有了溫床。第四層是直接導火線——669年起高句麗遺民屢次反唐，670年原高句麗將領劍牟岑扶高句麗王室安舜在百濟故地建高句麗復興政權，唐遣高侃鎮壓，安舜南逃後為新羅文武王收容，封為高句麗王並建報德國，新羅藉此高舉反唐旗幟；671年新羅攻佔泗沘、奪取唐的熊津都督府並建所夫里州，同盟至此破裂。上元元年（674）唐高宗改扶金仁問、遣劉仁軌東征，戰爭全面化。
causeEn: The war had four layers of cause. The deepest was the distribution of power on the peninsula. In 660 Silla joined the Tang to destroy Baekje, and in 668 it destroyed Goguryeo together with the Tang, so that Silla already held most of the country south of the Han river. After the fall of Goguryeo the Tang set up the Protectorate General to Pacify the East at Pyongyang, divided the land into commanderies and counties, registered the households, moved the people inland, and claimed to govern the whole peninsula in the name of that office; both sides wanted the sole right to dispose of it. The second layer was the gap between the promise and its keeping. Emperor Taizong had undertaken to hand the old lands of Baekje and the territory south of Pyongyang to Silla in return for its military help; Taizong died before the conquest of Goguryeo was completed and Gaozong later went back on the word, so Silla held itself to have been cheated. The third layer was the impossibility of settling the surrendered populations. Large numbers of Goguryeo and Baekje people were moved inland or folded into the Silla commanderies, and that became fertile ground for local resistance. The fourth layer was the immediate spark. From 669 the surviving Goguryeo rose repeatedly against the Tang, and in 670 the former Goguryeo general Geom Moseum set the Goguryeo royal house, An Shun, on the old lands of Baekje; the Tang sent Gao Kan to put the rising down; An Shun fled south and was taken in by King Munmu of Silla, who made him king of Goguryeo and established the state of Boguk for him, and Silla raised its banner against the Tang under that cover. In 671 Silla took Sabi, seized the Tang office of the dufu of Xiongjin and set up the prefecture of Sopuri, and the alliance broke down from that point. In the first year of Shangyuan (674) Gaozong turned instead to Kim Inmun and sent Liu Renjgui east, and the war became general.
impact: 羅唐戰爭的結果重塑了東北亞。對新羅而言，藉清除高句麗、百濟殘部並逐走唐軍，新羅在676年後完成半島統一，685年前後「始備九州」，統一大同江以南的行政格局由此定型，並在此後數百年維持，直到993年高麗在契丹戰爭之後再度統一半島。對唐而言，這是一場結構性失敗：安東都護府於676年底罷撤、徙治遼東故城，熊津都督府自泗沘徙建安故城，扶餘隆與高寶藏建唐室羈縻都督府的計畫落空，高句麗、百濟王族藉唐或藉新羅復國的預想徹底破滅；但唐廷也把經略重心移向遼東與西域的吐蕃，這條政策最終釀成692至698年的唐渤海戰爭與渤海建國，唐羅關係隨之惡化。技術上，新羅在戰中吸收唐的冶鐵、鑄造與馬具技術，冶鐵業成為新羅的支柱產業，鐵製品大量輸往日本，形成東亞知名的鐵器市場。制度上，新羅借戰爭集權，執事大等分割王權的格局被打破，國王直轄六部與州郡，國家結構由此定型。
impactEn: The outcome of the Luo-Tang war reshaped northeast Asia. For Silla, clearing away the Goguryeo and Baekje remnants and driving out the Tang completed the unification of the peninsula; around 685 it first set up the nine provinces, the administrative shape of the country south of the Taedong river was thereby fixed and held for the centuries that followed, until Goryeo unified the peninsula again in 993 after its war with the Khitan. For the Tang this was a structural failure. The Protectorate General to Pacify the East was abolished at the end of 676 and its seat moved to the old city of Liaodong, the dufu office of Xiongjin was moved from Sabi to the old city of Jian'an, the plan of Buyeo Lung and Go Bojang to set up a Tang client office came to nothing, and the hope of the Goguryeo and Baekje royal houses to restore their states by way of the Tang or of Silla failed outright. At the same time the Tang court shifted the centre of its policy towards Liaodong and towards the Tibetans of the western regions, and that policy produced in the end the Tang-Balhae war of 692 to 698 and the founding of Balhae, with Tang-Silla relations souring accordingly. In technical terms Silla absorbed Tang ironworking, casting and harness technology during the war, the iron industry became a pillar of the Silla economy, and Silla iron went out in quantity to Japan, forming the East Asian market in iron goods. Institutionally the war let the monarchy centralise: the arrangement by which the jipdaedale shared the king's power was broken, the king administered the six ministries and the commanderies directly, and the structure of the state was thereby settled.
result: 羅唐戰爭以唐軍退出朝鮮半島、新羅完成統一收場，雙方都付了代價。過程上，670年代前期唐軍在平壤、泗沘一線連敗，669年起高句麗遺民每年反唐，扶餘隆等百濟宗室困守長安，唐方在半島上既無援軍也無持久補給；新羅雖勝，卻把主力消耗在攻城與遠征上，國內兵源與糧食同樣吃緊。676年薛仁貴在伎伐浦與新羅交鋒，唐軍敗績，雙方罷兵，新羅不得不在同一年放棄把戰事推向唐軍殘部與新佔區的打算。收束上，唐廷罷安東都護府，平壤等地的唐軍與官吏撤出，邊界大致以大同江為界，新羅取得大同江以南的實控；677年唐冊封新羅王為帶方郡王，以名號換取和平；735年唐正式承認新羅對半島南部的控制。勝負之外是結構性的判斷：唐軍在半島上缺乏足夠的援軍與持久的補給線，新羅則能以本土城池消耗遠征軍隊——這條關於遠征的教訓，後來被唐廷用於處理北方草原與西域問題，而新羅的守城經驗，則成為統一新羅抵禦渤海與應對唐代使節的基礎。
resultEn: The Luo-Tang war ended with the Tang army leaving the Korean peninsula and Silla completing the unification of it, but both sides paid for it. In the course of events, the Tang lost in succession on the Pyongyang and Sabi front in the early 670s; from 669 the surviving Goguryeo rose every year, and Baekje princes such as Buyeo Lung were stuck at Chang'an; the Tang on the peninsula had neither reinforcements nor a durable supply. Silla won, but it had spent its strength on sieges and on long marches, and recruitment and grain inside the kingdom were strained in turn. In 676 Xue Rengui engaged the Silla at Jibeolpo and the Tang army was beaten, both sides stopped fighting, and Silla had to give up in that same year the plan of carrying the war to the Tang remnants and to the ground it had taken. The closing moves were these: the Tang court abolished the Protectorate General to Pacify the East, the troops and officials of Pyongyang and the other garrisons withdrew, the boundary between the two states came to rest roughly along the Taedong river, and Silla gained effective control of everything south of it; in 677 the Tang invested the Silla king as ruler of the Jibang commandery, buying peace with a title; and in 735 the Tang formally recognised Silla's control of the southern peninsula. Beyond the score sheet lies the structural verdict. The Tang army on the peninsula lacked the reinforcements and the durable supply line it needed, while Silla could use its own cities to exhaust an expeditionary army. That lesson about the expedition was read afterwards by the Tang court in its handling of the northern steppe and the western regions, and the defensive experience it taught Silla became the basis on which unified Silla later faced Balhae and the envoys of the Tang.
